visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a rectangular white cosmetic jar with a golden lid labeled WSTYLE. The jar is set against a background of white luxury product boxes in a bright, neutral studio setting. (2) A woman with light brown hair tied back and wearing a beige camisole appears. She has white cream applied to her face and neck. She uses a small silver spatula to scoop out more cream and brings it toward her mouth in a playful, cute gesture. (3) Multiple close-up shots follow as the woman uses her fingertips to apply the thick, opaque white mask cream to her cheeks, nose, and forehead. The cream's texture is rich and smooth. (4) The woman poses with her full face covered in the white mask, looking into the camera with a cheerful expression. She then rubs the leftover cream from her hands onto her arms and elbows. (5) The scene shifts to a bedroom where a hand spreads a clean white towel over a pillow on a bed with white linens and a wooden headboard, suggesting a night-time routine. (6) In morning light, the woman is shown with clear, glowing skin. She touches her face with her fingers, demonstrating the supple and radiant result of the skincare treatment.
